report_type.description: The field 'report_type' indicates the type ('type': http://purl.org/dc/terms/type) of report ('report': http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/IAO_0000088) generated by the EnzyWizard-Disorder software ('software': https://schema.org/SoftwareApplication).

disordered_region_statistics.description: The field 'disordered_region_statistics' indicates the summary statistics ('statistics': http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/STATO_0000039) of intrinsically disordered regions ('intrinsically disordered region': https://disprot.org/ontology) calculated from the protein structure ('protein structure': http://edamontology.org/data_1537).

disordered_region_count.description: The field 'disordered_region_count' indicates the count ('count': http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/STATO_0000047) of intrinsically disordered regions ('intrinsically disordered region': https://disprot.org/ontology).

max_disordered_region_length.description: The field 'max_disordered_region_length' indicates the maximum sequence length ('maximum': http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/STATO_0000150; 'sequence length': http://edamontology.org/data_1249) of intrinsically disordered regions ('intrinsically disordered region': https://disprot.org/ontology).

total_disordered_region_length.description: The field 'total_disordered_region_length' indicates the total sequence length ('sequence length': http://edamontology.org/data_1249) of intrinsically disordered regions ('intrinsically disordered region': https://disprot.org/ontology).

disordered_regions.description: The field 'disordered_regions' indicates intrinsically disordered regions ('intrinsically disordered region': https://disprot.org/ontology) in the protein structure ('protein structure': http://edamontology.org/data_1537).

disordered_region_length.description: The field 'disordered_region_length' indicates the sequence length ('sequence length': http://edamontology.org/data_1249) of the intrinsically disordered region ('intrinsically disordered region': https://disprot.org/ontology).

residues.description: The field 'residues' indicates the residues ('residue': http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/GENO_0000782) included in the intrinsically disordered region ('intrinsically disordered region': https://disprot.org/ontology).

residue_index.description: The field 'residue_index' indicates the index ('index': http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/NCIT_C25390) of the residue ('residue': http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/GENO_0000782).

residue_name.description: The field 'residue_name' indicates the name ('name': http://xmlns.com/foaf/0.1/name) of the residue ('residue': http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/GENO_0000782), using one-letter code ('one-letter code': https://iupac.qmul.ac.uk/AminoAcid/A2021.html) to represent.
